requirements.quote:
The Event numbers (1-28) utilized in this state machine description
   aid in specifying the behavior of the BGP state machine.
   Implementations MAY use these numbers to provide network management
   information.
requirements.condition: when providing network management information about BGP FSM events
requirements.required_behavior: MAY use the event numbers 1-28 from this state machine description to provide network management information; use of these numbers is optional
requirements.why_checkable: Management event reporting can be inspected to determine whether it uses the permitted FSM event numbers, without requiring implementations to use them.
